## Happy Path Tests

### QA-ROT006-HP-01: Style picker visible in modal header

**AC validated:** AC #1
**Preconditions:** App loaded, at least one project exists or board is empty

**Steps:**
1. Click "New Project" button on the board
2. Observe the modal header

**Expected result:** Modal opens. A row of 6 style icons is visible in the header, to the left of the close button. One icon appears active (terracotta background).

---

### QA-ROT006-HP-02: Switch form style — values preserved

**AC validated:** AC #2
**Preconditions:** Project form modal is open in Classic style

**Steps:**
1. Type "My Test Project" in the title field
2. Type "A description here" in the description field
3. Click the Sentence style icon in the style picker
4. Observe the form

**Expected result:** Form re-renders in Sentence style. The title "My Test Project" and description "A description here" are still present in their respective fields.

---

### QA-ROT006-HP-03: Style preference persists across modal close/reopen

**AC validated:** AC #3
**Preconditions:** App loaded; project form has been opened at least once

**Steps:**
1. Open project form
2. Select "Seed Packet" style
3. Close the modal (click X or press Escape)
4. Click "New Project" to reopen the modal
5. Observe the style picker and form layout

**Expected result:** Modal opens in Seed Packet style. The Seed Packet icon in the picker is active.

---

### QA-ROT006-HP-04: Style preference persists across page reload

**AC validated:** AC #4
**Preconditions:** App loaded in a non-private browser tab

**Steps:**
1. Open project form
2. Select "Envelope" style
3. Close the modal
4. Reload the page (Cmd+R / F5)
5. Open the project form

**Expected result:** Form opens in Envelope style. Preference was persisted via idb-keyval.

---

### QA-ROT006-HP-05 through HP-10: Submit from each style

**AC validated:** AC #5

Repeat the following for each style: Classic, Sentence, Seed Packet, Two-Beat, Envelope, Live Preview.

**Steps:**
1. Open project form; select the target style
2. Enter title: "Style Test [style name]"
3. Enter description: "Test description"
4. Select a color (any)
5. Select an icon (any)
6. Select section: "Seeds"
7. Add tag: "test-tag"
8. Click Save / submit

**Expected result:** Modal closes. A new project card appears in the Seeds section with the correct title, color, icon, and tag. Project is visible after page reload.

| Test ID | Style |
|---|---|
| HP-05 | Classic |
| HP-06 | Sentence |
| HP-07 | Seed Packet |
| HP-08 | Two-Beat |
| HP-09 | Envelope |
| HP-10 | Live Preview |

---

### QA-ROT006-HP-11: Live Preview updates in real time

**AC validated:** AC #6
**Preconditions:** Project form open in Live Preview style

**Steps:**
1. Select "Live Preview" style
2. Begin typing in the title field, one character at a time
3. Observe the preview card on the left after each keystroke
4. Type in the description field; observe preview
5. Select a color; observe preview
6. Select an icon; observe preview

**Expected result:** Preview card updates after every keystroke in title and description fields. Color and icon changes reflect immediately in the preview card.

---

### QA-ROT006-HP-12: Two-Beat step transition

**AC validated:** AC #7
**Preconditions:** Project form open in Two-Beat style

**Steps:**
1. Select "Two-Beat" style
2. Observe Step 1 (title field only visible)
3. Type a title
4. Click "Next" or equivalent step-advance control
5. Observe transition

**Expected result:** Step 2 appears with a smooth animated transition (Framer Motion). Step 2 shows description, section, color, icon, tags fields. Title entered in Step 1 is still present.

---

## Edge Case Tests

### QA-ROT006-EC-01: Switch style with all fields filled

**Preconditions:** All fields filled (title, description, section, color, icon, tags, next tiny step)

**Steps:**
1. Fill all fields in Classic style
2. Cycle through all 6 styles one by one
3. Return to Classic style

**Expected result:** All field values are preserved through every style switch. No data loss.

---

### QA-ROT006-EC-02: Submit with only title filled (all styles)

**Preconditions:** Project form open

**Steps:**
1. For each style: enter only a title, leave all other fields empty, click Save

**Expected result:** Project is created with title only. Description, tags, color, icon use their default values. No validation error for optional fields.

---

### QA-ROT006-EC-03: Attempt to submit with empty title (all styles)

**Steps:**
1. For each style: leave title empty, click Save

**Expected result:** Validation error appears. Form does not submit. Error message is visible and readable (not in red — terracotta or amber).

---

### QA-ROT006-EC-04: Two-Beat — navigate back to Step 1

**Steps:**
1. Open Two-Beat style
2. Enter title, advance to Step 2
3. Click "Back" or equivalent
4. Observe Step 1

**Expected result:** Step 1 reappears. Title field contains the previously entered value.

---

### QA-ROT006-EC-05: Live Preview — long title overflow

**Steps:**
1. Open Live Preview style
2. Type a very long title (80+ characters)
3. Observe the preview card

**Expected result:** Preview card title truncates or wraps gracefully. No overflow outside the card boundary. No layout break.

---

### QA-ROT006-EC-06: Rapid style switching

**Steps:**
1. Open project form
2. Enter a title
3. Click through all 6 style icons in rapid succession (< 1 second apart)
4. Observe the final rendered style

**Expected result:** Final style selected renders correctly. No visual glitches, no console errors, title preserved throughout.

---

### QA-ROT006-EC-07: Private browsing mode (IndexedDB unavailable)

**Preconditions:** Open app in a private/incognito window

**Steps:**
1. Open project form
2. Select "Sentence" style
3. Close and reopen modal

**Expected result:** Style may not persist (IndexedDB unavailable). App does not crash. A graceful degradation message or silent fallback to Classic is acceptable. No console errors that break the app.

---

### QA-ROT006-EC-08: Edit existing project — style preserved, values pre-populated

**Steps:**
1. Select "Seed Packet" style as preference
2. Create a project with title "Edit Test" in Seeds section
3. Click edit on the project card
4. Observe the form

**Expected result:** Modal opens in Seed Packet style (preference respected). All fields pre-populated with the project's values.

---

## Regression Tests

### QA-ROT006-RG-01: Classic form create/edit still works

**Preconditions:** formStyle preference set to Classic (default)

**Steps:**
1. Create a new project using Classic style
2. Verify it appears on the board
3. Edit the project; change the title
4. Verify the change on the board

**Expected result:** No regressions. Classic form behaves identically to pre-ROT-006 behavior.

---

### QA-ROT006-RG-02: Modal close still works from all styles

**Steps:**
1. For each style: open form, enter partial data, press Escape

**Expected result:** Modal closes cleanly. No projects created. No state leak.

---

### QA-ROT006-RG-03: viewMode preference still persists independently

**Steps:**
1. Set viewMode to "gallery"
2. Set formStyle to "envelope"
3. Reload page
4. Verify both preferences restored independently

**Expected result:** Gallery view shown; Envelope form style active. The two GardenState fields persist independently.

---

### QA-ROT006-RG-04: Drag and drop unaffected

**Steps:**
1. Set formStyle to any non-Classic style
2. Drag a project between sections
3. Reload; verify position

**Expected result:** Drag and drop works correctly. No hydration errors introduced by the new formStyle state.

---

### QA-ROT006-RG-05: Demo data clear still works

**Steps:**
1. Load app with demo data
2. Set formStyle to "sentence"
3. Clear demo data
4. Verify board is empty; formStyle preference still "sentence"

**Expected result:** Projects cleared; formStyle preference unchanged.

---

## Accessibility Tests

### QA-ROT006-AC-01: Keyboard navigation to style picker

**AC validated:** AC #8

**Steps:**
1. Open project form using keyboard (Tab to "New Project" button, Enter)
2. Tab into the modal
3. Tab to the style picker icons
4. Use arrow keys to navigate between style icons
5. Press Enter on a style

**Expected result:** Focus moves to style picker. Arrow keys cycle through icons. Enter selects a style. Form updates. All without mouse.

---

### QA-ROT006-AC-02: Focus trap in modal

**Steps:**
1. Open project form
2. Tab through all interactive elements
3. Continue tabbing past the last element

**Expected result:** Focus wraps back to the first interactive element in the modal. Focus never leaves the modal while it is open.

---

### QA-ROT006-AC-03: Style picker icons have accessible labels

**Steps:**
1. Open project form
2. Inspect style picker icons with a screen reader (VoiceOver / NVDA)
3. Navigate to each icon

**Expected result:** Screen reader announces the style name for each icon (via `aria-label`). Not just the icon glyph.

---

### QA-ROT006-AC-04: Form labels in all styles

**Steps:**
1. For each style: inspect form inputs with a screen reader

**Expected result:** Every input has an associated label (announced by screen reader). No input is identified only by placeholder text.

---

### QA-ROT006-AC-05: Color contrast — all styles

**Steps:**
1. Open each form style
2. Run automated contrast check (axe DevTools or Lighthouse)

**Expected result:** All text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text). No failures introduced by the new form styles.
